context: An elderly couple reminisce in the evening
purpose: Teach: 正体/気力/叫ぶ/誘わ/親族/見つめる/うれしく/年上

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、お前の正体を見抜けなくて、悩んだものさ。
lines.en: When I was younger, I couldn't figure out who you really were. It bothered me.
lines.style: Slow, gentle. Slight nostalgic weight on the admission. Wry undertone—not quite regretful, more amused at his own blindness. Eyes soft but steady.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あら、私だって気力で隠してた部分、あったわよ。
lines.en: Well, I was hiding parts of myself too, you know. It took real effort.
lines.style: Knowing smile in the voice. Warm, a little mischievous. Light and tender—not defensive, just matter-of-fact about her own secrets. Breath easy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お互いの親族から、いろいろ言われたな。
lines.en: We got quite the commentary from both sides of the family back then.
lines.style: Dry, conversational. Moderate pace. A flick of amusement at the memory—not bitterness, just the plain weight of how much people had opinions. Small pause between clauses.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 年上の伯母さん、特に厳しかった。
lines.en: Your older aunt was the harshest, I remember.
lines.style: Light shake of the head in the tone. Rueful but not wounded—this is old ground, walked over many times now. A small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 同窓会に誘われたが、二人で行こうか。
lines.en: I got invited to the reunion. Should we go together?
lines.style: Casual question with a lift at the end. Calm but with a quiet hopefulness underneath—testing whether she wants this too. Straightforward, no performance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うれしくて、もう何着るか悩んでるわ。
lines.en: I'm so happy I'm already fretting about what to wear.
lines.style: Bright, almost girlish delight. Energy rises on the second half. Slightly flustered in the best way—the kind of worry that comes from genuine excitement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の写真、二人で見つめる時間、いいな。
lines.en: You know, sitting together looking at old photos—there's something really nice about that.
lines.style: Tender and close. Slow, savoring each word. Voice finds warmth without reaching for it. Gentle trailing off into contentment.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 思わず叫ぶような驚き、人生にはあったわね。
lines.en: Life gave us surprises that made us gasp. That's the truth of it.
lines.style: Soft, almost reverent. Pause before 'gasp'—the weight of memory. Slight tremor of feeling underneath steadiness. Philosophical but grounded. Trails away gently.
